requiredPlannerCapability: Deterministic iterative detours across multiple blocking obstacles with all-segment revalidation
notes: Current planner detours only the first blocker; v1 must preserve planHash while chaining enough waypoints to clear the remaining S-curve rocks.

requiredPlannerCapability: Same deterministic multi-obstacle detour logic on longer routes with stable candidate ordering
notes: Long-range version keeps the same geometry stress but adds more room for planHash drift if waypoint ordering is not fixed.

requiredPlannerCapability: Corridor-safe detour selection that reasons about both corridor walls and the downstream blocker
notes: This is the canonical multi-obstacle corridor case; a single lateral detour is not enough once the second obstacle is considered.

requiredPlannerCapability: Deterministic corridor navigation over longer distances without looped replanning
notes: Use this to prove the planner stays bounded when the corridor remains tight over a longer run.

requiredPlannerCapability: Multiple-gate reasoning without overreacting to the first blocker
notes: Currently passes under forgiving geometry; v1 must keep it deterministic while ensuring the candidate path is still revalidated against all nearby gates.

requiredPlannerCapability: Offset gate traversal on longer routes with stable plan scoring and no silent replan
notes: Long-range offset gates help catch planHash instability that only shows up once the route has extra distance to accumulate numerical drift.

requiredPlannerCapability: Terminal target approach that can route around a blocking obstacle without changing the locked arrival envelope
notes: This should remain a clean solvable case once the planner can chain more than one obstacle-aware segment.

requiredPlannerCapability: Fail-closed terminal-envelope validation when the target is close to obstacle padding
notes: If the route cannot keep the target envelope safely separate from the obstacle padding, the planner must reject instead of silently accepting an unsafe terminal segment.

requiredPlannerCapability: Multi-candidate deterministic reasoning across a dense field without grid-style explosion
notes: Proves the planner can chain several obstacle-aware turns in a denser field while keeping candidate count bounded.

requiredPlannerCapability: Long-horizon deterministic route construction with bounded waypoint depth and stable scoring
notes: This is the longest solvable stress case; the acceptance numbers intentionally leave room for the route to be longer than the 1000m field while still remaining deterministic.

requiredPlannerCapability: Fail-closed reject path when no safe route exists within the waypoint budget
notes: No route should be synthesized here; the planner must emit a structured reject/unsolvable reason instead of looping or changing the locked plan.
